```{r}
#| label: setup
library(disasterMaps)

tzone <- "America/Los_Angeles"
```

## Data




```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| warning: false
data_dir <- system.file("extdata", "fire", "population", package = "disasterMaps")
tiles_3857 <- load_population(data_dir, re_run = TRUE, cache_dir = tempdir())

w <- compute_windows(tiles_3857, tzone)

lon_limits <- range(tiles_3857$longitude)
lat_limits <- range(tiles_3857$latitude)
zoom <- 10
```

## Population map




```{r}
#| label: population-map
p1 <- population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom
)
p1
```

## Highways




```{r}
#| label: highways
population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom,
  highway_detail = "major"
)
```

## Rivers




```{r}
#| label: rivers
population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom,
  river_detail = "major"
)
```

## Terrain




```{r}
#| label: terrain
population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom,
  show_terrain = TRUE
)
```

## State borders




```{r}
#| label: state-borders
population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom,
  show_state_borders = TRUE
)
```

## City labels

```{r}
#| label: city-labels
cities <- data.frame(
  label = "Example City",
  lon = mean(lon_limits),
  lat = mean(lat_limits)
) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(3857)

population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom,
  labels = cities
)
```
